findings.body: The counter excludes every log entry containing `status`, but recovered turns can have only such an entry. `src/forge/codex.py:189–197` records a turn recovered after a crash before its start was logged by appending only its completion record; `tests/test_codex_resume.py:514–557` exercises this supported case. The next brief therefore undercounts the round, potentially saying `Build ...` after the first recovered turn instead of `Fix round 2 ...`. Count distinct recorded conversation/turn pairs, including recovery-only records.
